answer: PoA applies an exponential temporal half-life to reputation, requiring sustained honest service to preserve influence. EigenTrust factorization turns weighted attestations into centrality: a freshly spawned sybil vertex has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks trusted incoming support. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity prevents isolated sybil clusters from bootstrapping trust; neither an ocean of fabricated edges nor nectar-like collusion supplies the support needed to pass consensus.
